title: Questions about Compounding of Offences
description: Natural language queries a user may ask about:

queries: Can an offence under section 88 be compounded after prosecution has started?
What is the condition for compounding an offence under section 89?
Can a complaint be filed under section 92 without leave of the court?
What is the maximum amount that can be imposed as a fine for a compounded offence?
Can an offence be compounded without payment of a prescribed amount?
